subject.title: Resume chat after reconnect via sequence cursor (gateway + mobile clients)

question: Should this workstream close through the existing `chat.history.inFlightRun` snapshot design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100277, or should a separate `afterSeq` cursor remain part of the product direction?
rationale: The original protocol cursor PR was closed unmerged, Android now uses the existing snapshot contract, and the protected maintainer label means automation should not decide whether the cursor proposal is abandoned or still desired.

options.title: Finish InFlightRun Recovery
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100277 as the remaining canonical implementation path and close this issue after it lands or is intentionally rejected.

options.title: Revive Cursor Design
options.body: Keep this issue open as a gateway protocol design item and require a new narrow `afterSeq` proposal with compatibility proof for all clients.

options.title: Split Follow-Up
options.body: Land the Apple snapshot fix now and open a separate protocol-performance issue only if full-history bandwidth remains a measured problem.

recommendation.title: Finish InFlightRun Recovery
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100277 as the remaining canonical implementation path and close this issue after it lands or is intentionally rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current issue, authored the related Android and Apple reconnect work, and can decide whether the old cursor direction is still wanted.
